summary_en: This pilot study tests mosunetuzumab, a CD20xCD3 bispecific antibody, in adults with chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) or small lymphocytic lymphoma (SLL), given alone or with a BTK inhibitor. Mosunetuzumab is given as a subcutaneous injection for up to 17 cycles; cycle length is not stated, and participants on a BTK inhibitor continue it during treatment. The study aims to evaluate clearance of detectable minimal residual disease; the primary outcome measure is not stated, and the study is listed as Phase 1/Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio piloto evalúa mosunetuzumab, un anticuerpo biespecífico CD20xCD3, en adultos con leucemia linfocítica crónica (LLC) o linfoma linfocítico pequeño (LLP), administrado solo o junto con un inhibidor de BTK. Mosunetuzumab se administra como inyección subcutánea por hasta 17 ciclos; la duración de cada ciclo no se indica, y los participantes que toman un inhibidor de BTK continúan con él durante el tratamiento. El estudio busca evaluar la eliminación de la enfermedad mínima residual detectable; la medida de resultado principal no se indica, y el estudio figura como Fase 1/Fase 2.
who_for: Diagnosis of CLL or SLL under 2018 iwCLL guidelines
BTK inhibitor arm: on continuous BTK inhibitor for over 12 months, with over 2 months at a stable dose
BCL2 inhibitor arm: finished BCL2 inhibitor-based therapy less than 12 months before enrollment
Detectable minimal residual disease of at least 10e-4 in blood or bone marrow by NGS assay
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 2 or lower
not_for: Bulky disease with any lymph node over 5 cm or absolute lymphocyte count over 100,000/microliter
Clinical progression of CLL at enrollment
CAR T-cell therapy within 30 days, or radioimmunotherapy within 12 weeks, before study therapy
History of solid organ or allogeneic stem cell transplant
Known or suspected Richter's transformation or CNS involvement of CLL
